description.from:
**Phase 5 of MVP** under `PPY-54055d`.

## Intent

As a publication operator, I want to record finding-level steering, choose among rewrite options, apply patches myself, and see a diff — so the loop stays interactive and externally attributable copy is never auto-published.

## Done when

- Operator can record per-finding decisions: skip, rewrite, delete, keep, add.
- Operator sees options for rewrite findings and records choose / edit / reject / regenerate-with-guidance.
- Operator sees a **diff** (original vs working draft) after apply, not an auto-published rewrite.
- Working draft changes only when a human apply is recorded.
- Provenance retained: original draft, findings, finding decisions, options, chosen option ids, model/version, retrieved sources, change log, human apply/approve/reject.
- External publish requires human approval.
- Quality metrics logged over time: accepted revisions, deletions, unsupported-claim rate, reader edits, post-publication corrections.

## Depends on

Verifier + acceptance gate.

Migrated from PPY-9edba1.
description.to:
## Intent

As a publication operator or AI-assisted editor, I want Limatus to provide reviewable rewrite suggestions for either selected findings or the entire marked-up draft, so a capable model can improve the whole document coherently without being forced through a finding-by-finding ritual.

## Done when

- The suggestion surface supports both targeted options and a holistic, document-level candidate mode.
- A holistic candidate receives the complete draft, style profile, findings or annotations, and reference samples; individual finding decisions are optional guidance, not a prerequisite.
- Results are suggestions only: candidate text, rationale, unresolved questions, factual-verification warnings, and a reviewable diff.
- The source draft is never changed. Applying a candidate remains an explicit user action.
- The verifier can compare an original with a selected candidate or working copy.
- Optional provenance may retain inputs, model/version, selected candidate, and approvals for teams that need it; it is not required to obtain suggestions.
- External publish always requires human approval.

## Gherkin

Feature: Holistic rewrite suggestions
  Scenario: Suggest a cohesive document revision
    Given a draft, portable style profile, and diagnostic annotations
    When an editor requests a holistic rewrite suggestion
    Then Limatus returns one or more non-destructive candidate revisions with a diff
    And each candidate identifies factual-verification risks and unresolved questions
    And the original draft remains unchanged

  Scenario: Use targeted suggestions when they are appropriate
    Given selected findings from a diagnosis
    When an editor requests targeted rewrite options
    Then Limatus returns options limited to those findings
    And a finding-level decision record is optional

## Out of scope

Unattended rewriting, auto-apply, auto-publish, and detector-score optimization.

Reframed from PPY-9edba1.

title.to: Holistic rewrite suggestions and diff review
